verdict.rationale: Aleph documents headcount planning backed by live HRIS, ATS, and ERP data, alongside 150+ no-code connectors that consolidate cross-system data into a single source of truth with table-combining logic. That covers the HRIS-plus-books half of the story. CRM or pipeline connectors and payroll systems are never named, so the pipeline half rests only on the generic connector count. Missing for 10: explicit CRM/pipeline connector evidence, named payroll connectors, a documented example of headcount and pipeline data sitting in the same model as GL actuals, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
